data.readmeSummary:
## UK Planning Applications (planning.data.gov.uk)

Provides daily-updated records of UK planning applications harvested from planning.data.gov.uk. Each record corresponds to a single planning application and contains unique identifiers and reference numbers, the responsible local planning authority, a textual description of the proposal, decision date and application date range, and a geographic location point. Data focuses on applications published to the planning.data.gov.uk platform and is formatted as structured, authority-level planning metadata suitable for monitoring planning activity, extracting leads, and integrating into property/proptech workflows.

## Use cases

- Construction and trades lead generation — tracking new applications by authority or by time period.  
- Property research and proptech — monitoring planning activity and development patterns by area.
